program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((a (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0))))))
         (b (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) (objects g 0))))))
         (diff (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p b))) a))
         (anchor (first (find-color g 9)))
         (placed (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first anchor) (first p)) (+ (second anchor) (second p)))) diff)))
    (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) placed 6)))
